item.title: Michigan City’s SoLa Development Agreement To Expire Dec. 31
item.description: After nearly five years of negotiations, amendments, and extensions, the Michigan City Redevelopment Commission has voted to deny any further extensions of the SOLA development agreement and allow the agreement to expire as of Wednesday, Dec. 31, should all remaining milestones not be met.

item.title: Interest is strong in Rabbit Ridge, Syracuse
item.description: Interest continues to be strong in Rabbit Ridge, the new 55-plus housing addition being built in Syracuse.

item.title: Interra Credit Union welcomes Voors
item.description: Jeremy Bender, head of agribusiness lending, is thrilled to welcome Dave Voors, senior vice president and agribusiness lender, to the Ag Lending Department, serving the Fort Wayne market.

item.title: Longtime Local Business Pilcher’s Shoe Store Earns Chamber Honor
item.description: The North Webster–Tippecanoe Township Chamber of Commerce recognized Pilcher’s Shoe Store as its December Member of the Month, honoring the business for its long-standing commitment to quality service, community involvement and local tradition.

item.title: Lessons in giving
item.description: “Everybody needs a little help,” said Lisa Bryant, “We need to do what we can for each other. We need to learn to give.”

item.title: Children’s Librarian Is Up To The Challenge
item.description: “Please interrupt us,” read the signs in the Syracuse Public Library children’s department.

item.title: Construction Work continues on Wawasee High auditorium, Milford School, other projects progressing
item.description: Construction is continuing across multiple Wawasee Community School Corp. projects, with district leaders highlighting major progress on a new performing arts center at Wawasee High School and the nearing completion of a new Milford Elementary building.

item.title: Bartlett, Thompson Running for Clay Township Trustee
item.description: Spencer Bartlett and Cheryl Thompson are running for Clay Township Trustee.

item.title: Mcgonagle named Middlebury Interra Credit Union Branch Manager
item.description: Liz Borntrager, vice president and senior manager of retail delivery for Interra Credit Union, announced Kelly Mcgonagle has been named assistant vice president and retail branch manager at Interra’s Middlebury Branch.

item.title: Forte Residential Earns Accreditation
item.description: Forte Residential is celebrating its accreditation of Person-Centered Excellence, awarded by the Council on Quality & Leadership
